newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE $64, MODERATE - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE $64, MODERATE - USDA.

text.p: Trade moderate in the panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 3,200 slaughter steers and 1,800 heifers following the weekly movement of 88,400 head. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1076-1125 lbs 64.00.
